ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious User-Agents Related To Recon Tools
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects known suspicious (default) user-agents related to scanning/recon tools Note: Unmapped fields: cs-user-agent

sequences.query: (cs-user-agent = RGX(".*Wfuzz\\/.*") OR cs-user-agent = RGX(".*WPScan\\ v.*") OR cs-user-agent = RGX(".*Recon\\-ng\\/v.*") OR cs-user-agent = RGX(".*GIS\\ \\-\\ AppSec\\ Team\\ \\-\\ Project\\ Vision.*"))
